**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 is the document's only audit right running against us, and it satisfies the preferred position on all material terms:

| Playbook term (preferred) | § 22 |
|---|---|
| Max once per 12 months | ✅ "no more than once in any twelve-month period" (22.1) |
| 30 days' written notice | ✅ "at least thirty days' prior written notice" (22.1) |
| Business hours | ✅ "during normal business hours" plus no-unreasonable-disruption (22.1) |
| Off-site where possible | ✅ "conducted off-site where practicable" (22.1) |
| Independent auditor under confidentiality | ✅ (22.1) |
| Vendor cost unless underpayment > 5% | ✅ (22.2) |
| No direct system access | ✅ "may not access Customer systems directly," and also excludes unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and other suppliers' confidential information (22.2) |

Section 22.3 goes further in our favour: audit findings are our Confidential Information, usable only to enforce the Agreement, we get a copy of the final report, and payment of a shortfall closes out the audited quantity absent fraud or demonstrable error. A search of the full document surfaced no other inspection, verification, monitoring or remote-access rights, so there is no walk-away exposure hiding outside § 22.
